task:
Write Python 3 function solve(rows). First apply an audit filter to the ORIGINAL input positions, indexed from zero: omit positions whose index modulo 5 equals 3, except always retain the last input position. Rotate the retained rows LEFT by 2 positions modulo the retained length (empty stays empty). Apply the following rules to that transformed list: Rows are nonnegative integer quantities. Each order independently costs 8 cents per unit for its first 15 units and 7 thereafter. Cap each order at 133 cents before adding the orders. Return integer cents.
Return the requested value, without printing. Inputs follow the types specified. Do not mutate the input. Standard library is allowed.
